reuse.why: The change reuses getApproxNumberThreshold but bypasses the existing getScheduledAmount abstraction in all three changed consumers.

duplication.why: API serialization, forecast normalization, and transaction previews each independently implement the same amount-selection policy.

placement.why: Schedule amount policy belongs in shared/schedules.ts alongside getScheduledAmount, rather than being independently embedded in API serialization and forecast normalization.

scope.why: All edits concern schedule amount expectations, their API exposure, or directly related tests.

maintainability.why: Future policy changes require coordinating three implementations while the existing shared abstraction and its consumers remain separate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: scheduleModel.toExternal, normalizeSchedule, and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions implement amount selection locally instead of extending and calling shared/schedules.ts:getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: normalizeSchedule reshapes the same numeric/approximate/range dispatch found in API serialization and previews through amountValue and an operator fallback, without sharing the policy.

abstraction_drift.where: The existing getScheduledAmount helper remains unchanged while API serialization, forecast normalization, and preview generation independently implement the evolving policy.
